item.title: Trump swaps physical Iowa and Kansas rallies for tele-events
item.description: Due to Donald Trump calling off his final midterm appearances in Kansas and Iowa, the Republican National Committee has scheduled audio broadcasts across a minimum of twenty states.

item.title: নেতানিয়াহু কি ক্ষমতা রক্ষার্থে আরব জোট নিয়ে আশঙ্কা থেকেই হামলা চালাচ্ছেন
item.description: বিশ্লেষকদের অভিমত, আইজেনকট যেন আরব দলগুলোর সহায়তায় সরকার গঠনে উদ্বুদ্ধ না হন, সেই লক্ষ্যেই নেতানিয়াহু এই কৌশল অবলম্বন করছেন বলে ধারণা করা হচ্ছে।

item.title: Armenian lawmakers clash physically in parliament again
item.description: A legislative session in Armenia erupted into a physical brawl for the third time within thirty days following verbal insults directed at an opposition leader's relatives by a governing party representative.

item.title: Binance secures billions in digital assets following security breach
item.description: The chief executive of Binance indicated that the premier cryptocurrency exchange likely suffered a cyberattack, leading to the immobilization of over two billion dollars in digital currencies.

item.title: Patterson loses appeal and faces life sentence for mushroom poisoning
item.description: An appellate court in Victoria upheld a life prison sentence without parole for Erin Patterson regarding a fatal mushroom meal that caused three fatalities.

item.title: Finance ministry projects 7.3 percent second-quarter GDP growth
item.description: According to the finance ministry, the nation's economic expansion could reach 7.3 percent during the second quarter.

item.title: Envoy suggests independent ombudsman for public broadcaster Middle East reporting
item.description: The anti-semitism envoy suggested creating an independent ombudsman to oversee Middle East reporting by ABC and SBS, noting that public concern over the coverage's impact on Jewish Australians is significant.

item.title: Trading halted on Binance exchange following suspected cyber breach
item.description: Digital asset exchange Binance temporarily halted specific market transactions while various crypto firms locked billions in assets as authorities investigated an apparent security breach.

item.title: Houthi Movement Reports Multiple Strikes on Saudi Energy Sites
item.description: Houthi combatants asserted they targeted Saudi airports and petroleum installations in six separate operations. This development followed recent discussions in Tehran involving Iranian and regional representatives.

item.title: Indian Army Havaldar Kapil Pokhariya's Unconventional Boxing Journey
item.description: Raised in a small Uttarakhand village using homemade punching bags, Kapil Pokhariya drew inspiration from wrestler Roman Reigns. Known for his powerful hits, he earned the local moniker 'Khatima ka Russell' before entering the sport.

item.title: Binance Halts $2.5 Billion in Digital Assets Following Breach
item.description: Cryptocurrency platform Binance temporarily halted transactions to perform security verifications. The company announced it would fully reimburse any impacted funds resulting from the suspected breach.

item.title: Erin Patterson's Appeal Against Triple-Murder Convictions Rejected
item.description: An appellate court dismissed Erin Patterson's challenge against her murder convictions while increasing her punishment. She remained expressionless during the video proceeding as the court detailed the ruling.

item.title: US-Canada Tariffs Impact Kentucky Bourbon Sector
item.description: Bilateral trade tensions between the United States and Canada are negatively impacting Kentucky's multi-billion-dollar bourbon sector. The industry is currently facing economic strain linked to these broader geopolitical disputes.

item.title: Food Experts Suggest Consuming Scraps to Increase Fiber Intake
item.description: Nutrition researchers indicate that eating discarded vegetable peels, seeds, and stems can significantly boost daily fiber consumption. Utilizing these kitchen leftovers provides essential dietary benefits according to the experts.

item.title: Supreme Court Criticizes Ministry Over NCLT Operations
item.description: The Supreme Court stated that the Ministry has taken over the National Company Law Tribunal. The bench directed the tribunal leaders to provide administrative and infrastructure improvement plans within four weeks.

item.title: Ex-Bangladesh Air Force Member Connected to Hasina Clip Found Dead
item.description: A former Bangladesh air force official associated with a video concerning Hasina's departure has been discovered deceased. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death of the former military member.

item.title: In Delhi, BJP booth agents file deletion forms against Muslim voters living at their addresses
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, BJP BLAs submit nearly 68% of Form 7s seeking deletions as ‘objector’ in Mustafabad, all against Muslim electors citing ‘absent/permanently shifted’ or ‘death’. Key points: In Delhi, Muslim, Form, Mustafabad.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says four tankers struck mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: As reported by Al Jazeera, Iran's IRGC states four tankers have struck naval mines after using "unauthorised" Strait of Hormuz routes. Key points: Iran, Strait, Hormuz Iran, Hormuz.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Set to Weaken as Odisha and Andhra Affected
item.description: Heavy rains from cyclonic storm Arnab have impacted 17 southern districts in Odisha. Meanwhile, Andhra Pradesh reported five fatalities as the Chief Minister declared compensation measures.

item.title: I didn't know I was lacking in vitamin D until I collapsed at work
item.description: As reported by BBC Health, Doctors are finding vitamin D deficiency is increasingly widespread in the UK, especially in young people. Key points: Doctors, vitamin, lacking, until.

item.title: 'Titans' BO day 8: Jayasurya's film trails 'Aadu 3' by Rs 34.08 cr
item.description: As reported by TOI Entertainment, Titans affected the big screen on October 22, yet its box office results have fallen short of expectations. Key points: Titans, Jayasurya, Aadu, October.

item.title: Will repay political debt with interest: Neeraj Kumar on Lalan Singh
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, During the entire Legislative Council election, Lalan Singh did not even campaign in support of Neeraj, but rather gave moral support to Anant Singh. Key points: Neeraj Kumar, Lalan Singh During, Legislative Council, Lalan Singh.

item.title: France braces for ‘very high risk’ of disorder at Halloween protests
item.description: As reported by Al Jazeera, Authorities vow firm action against violence as yellow vest and student movements announce widespread demonstrations. Key points: France, Halloween, Authorities, france.

item.title: Bombshell confession in The Traitors as faithfuls finally turn the screw
item.description: As reported by BBC Entertainment, Could the faithfuls finally come good in Thursday's penultimate episode?. Key points: Bombshell, The Traitors, Thursday, faithfuls.

item.title: Gadkari’s 140 kmph no-challan proposal faces legal, road safety hurdles
item.description: As reported by Times of India, Gadkari’s 140 kmph no. Key points: Gadkari, gadkari, challan, proposal.

item.title: Obsession Filmmaker Releases New YouTube Horror Short
item.description: Curry Barker, director of the movie Obsession, has released a five-minute horror short called Mama Bear on YouTube. The unsettling and graphic project is now available to stream online.

item.title: Udta Teer Completes First Week With Strong Box Office Numbers
item.description: Starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan, Udta Teer finished its opening week with over Rs 46 crore globally and Rs 31.25 crore domestically, beating rival films.

item.title: Gujarat Court Sentences Three to Life Imprisonment for Cow Slaughter
item.description: A court in Gujarat handed down life sentences to three individuals for slaughtering a cow, referencing Hindu texts like the Manusmriti and Vedas in the ruling.

item.title: Anantnag District Magistrate Voids Local Bar Elections
item.description: The District Magistrate of Anantnag invalidated the local Bar Association elections, pointing to infractions of official directives in the region.

item.title: Repaired Garments and Visible Mending Gain Popularity
item.description: Younger consumers are increasingly adopting fashion trends that feature noticeable patching and artistic mending instead of hiding clothing repairs.

item.title: Amazon CEO Projects Tens of Billions in Prime Video Revenue
item.description: According to Amazon chief executive Andy Jassy, Prime Video is positioned to generate tens of billions of dollars, aided by popular original titles.

item.title: Jassy Predicts AWS Will Reach $1 Trillion Amid Heavy Spending
item.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy stated that AWS aims for $1 trillion in revenue driven by artificial intelligence, though it requires continued high capital expenditure.

item.title: Box Office Earnings Slow for Vijay Deverakonda Starrer Ranabaali
item.description: After two weeks, Vijay Deverakonda's film Ranabaali reached Rs 78.90 crore worldwide and Rs 57.30 crore domestically, though ticket sales declined on day fourteen.

item.title: Noel Tata Appoints Close Counsel to Succeed Him at Trent
item.description: Noel has selected a prominent attorney and personal acquaintance to follow him at Trent. Questions have been raised regarding whether Tata Sons chairman Chandra was informed.

item.title: Intel Reports High Demand and Shortages for Budget Processors
item.description: Intel executives stated during an earnings call that consumer demand for Wildcat Lake budget processors exceeds current production capabilities. Chief Financial Officer David Zinsner confirmed these affordable laptop chips are completely sold out.

item.title: North Korea Conducts Weapon Tests as Kim Seeks Military Supremacy
item.description: State media reported that North Korea tested attack drones, cruise missiles, and rocket launchers. During the event, Kim Jong Un urged the accelerated advancement of AI and drone military applications.

item.title: Ex-West Bengal Minister Indranil Sen Placed in Police Custody
item.description: Former West Bengal tourism and culture minister Indranil Sen has been ordered into police custody for 13 days. He previously held office during the administration of Mamata Banerjee.

item.title: Pink Panther Star Elke Sommer Dies at Age 85
item.description: Actress Elke Sommer, famous for her 1960s Hollywood comedy and spy film roles, has passed away at 85. Born in Berlin during WWII, she starred alongside major actors like Paul Newman.

item.title: Top Court Examines Bank Accountability in Digital Arrest Scams
item.description: The Supreme Court is reviewing bank liability regarding financial losses from digital arrest scams. The RBI plans to release updated KYC rules by November 30, which the court wants to inspect.

item.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Earns Rs 5.90 Crore on Day 15
item.description: The Rajinikanth film Jailer 2 earned Rs 5.90 crore net domestically on its 15th day, bringing its cumulative Indian box office total to Rs 429.55 crore. The Tamil edition generated Rs 3.20 crore of that daily total, outperforming Coolie.

item.title: Sensex Gains 905 Points Driven by Fed Pause and Lower FPI Sales
item.description: The Sensex climbed 905 points following a US Federal Reserve rate pause and a reduction in foreign portfolio investor selling. This development boosted investor risk appetite, though external hurdles persist.

item.title: Dismissed US General Confesses to Disclosing Secret Files
item.description: An ousted American military officer has confessed to providing reporters with confidential intelligence concerning Ukraine and Iran. The admission follows the unauthorized sharing of classified national security materials.

item.title: Israel Revises Aviation Safety Protocols Post-Hijacking Attempt
item.description: Following an attempted incident involving a Flydubai aircraft, Israeli authorities have implemented a comprehensive upgrade to national airline security measures. The changes aim to prevent similar security breaches in the future.

item.title: পা লাগলে সালাম দেওয়ার প্রচলন ও ইসলাম
item.description: অনেਕੇ ভুলবশত কারো গায়ে পা লাগলে সালাম দেওয়াকে শিষ্টাচার মনে করেন। তবে ইসলামি শরিয়তে শারীরিক যোগাযোগের এ ধরনের পরিস্থিতিতে সালাম বা বিশেষ অঙ্গভঙ্গি প্রদর্শনের কোনো নির্দিষ্ট নিয়ম বা বিধান নেই।

item.title: Majority of Victorian Lawyers Adopt AI, Few Lower Fees
item.description: Studies show that 55 percent of legal professionals in Victoria now utilize artificial intelligence in their work, an increase from the previous year. Despite these efficiency improvements, only a quarter of these practitioners have reduced their charges for clients.

item.title: Supreme Court Criticizes Corporate Ministry Over Tribunals
item.description: The Supreme Court stated that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has taken over the National Company Law Tribunal and the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal. The remark highlights concerns regarding the independence of these judicial bodies.

item.title: Actor Patrick Stewart Passes Away at 86
item.description: The renowned X-Men and Star Trek star has died in Los Angeles at the age of 86. He had previously been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia.

item.title: PSG Secures Late Draw Against Struggling Manchester City
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain scored in the closing moments to secure a 1-1 draw against Manchester City. The result extends Manchester City's winless streak in the current Women's Champions League tournament.

item.title: No Majority in Israeli Election After Full Vote Count
item.description: Final tallies indicate that neither Benjamin Netanyahu's faction nor the opposing bloc secured enough seats to form a government. Both sides now face difficult negotiations to build a ruling coalition.

item.title: Congress urges BJP to evaluate setbacks in Nagpur and Varanasi
item.description: The Congress party has advised the BJP to analyze its recent electoral defeats in the constituencies of Nagpur and Varanasi.

item.title: Binance halts withdrawals following suspected major crypto cyberattack
item.description: Cryptocurrency platform Binance suspended withdrawals on Thursday amid a cyberattack. External estimates suggest attackers may have stolen billions.

item.title: Sony develops film adaptation of indie horror game Mouthwashing
item.description: Sony is adapting the indie horror game Mouthwashing into a movie. Karyn Kusama will direct the project, with the team behind The Invitation writing the script.

item.title: Trump administration seeks removal of leaked ICE personnel records
item.description: Efforts are underway by the Trump administration to remove leaked immigration enforcement personnel data. Icelandic web host FlokiNET maintained that publishing the records serves a public interest.

item.title: Bihar Museum secures spot in global top ten list
item.description: The Bihar Museum has entered the global top ten rankings, placing ahead of prominent institutions like the Louvre and the Met.

item.title: চার দিনের জাপান সফর শেষে দেশে ফিরলেন প্রধানমন্ত্রী
item.description: জাপান সরকারের প্রধানের আমন্ত্রণে চার দিনের সফর শেষ করে দেশে ফিরেছেন প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমান। গত সোমবার তিনি এই সফরে জাপান গিয়েছিলেন।

item.title: Reddit CEO states Google AI search features fail to generate traffic
item.description: During a Q3 2026 earnings call, Reddit CEO Steve Huffman stated that Google's AI-driven search tools fail to send traffic to the platform. This mirrors concerns raised by other online publishers regarding search visibility.

item.title: ADR reports Jan Suraaj collected Rs 101 crore and spent Rs 9 crore in FY25
item.description: According to ADR data for the 2025 financial year, the Jan Suraaj party collected Rs 101 crore while limiting its expenditures to Rs 9 crore.

item.title: Rugby panel clears Tadhg Furlong of groin grab allegation
item.description: Ireland player Tadhg Furlong has been exonerated by a disciplinary panel regarding accusations that he grabbed Gavin Coombes in the groin. The incident allegedly occurred during a United Rugby Championship match between Leinster and Munster.

item.title: Senior US military chief visits White House amid Iran considerations
item.description: A senior American commander made an uncommon trip to the White House. The meeting highlights potential military strike options against Iran under consideration.

item.title: Reflecting on Sonia Gandhi's 2007 remarks about entering politics
item.description: Sonia Gandhi moved to India to marry Rajiv Gandhi, who was working as a pilot without political goals at the time. She had anticipated living a quiet, private life alongside her husband and their two kids.
